money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local currency is the Sri Lankan Rupee (LKR). You can change Australian dollars for LKR at: the airport commercial banks in major centres Most major towns and cities have ATMs. Some ATMs don't accept international cards. You can withdraw cash from Visa and MasterCard cards at most major banks. Hotels and major shops will accept credit cards. Before you travel, ask your bank if your cards will work in Sri Lanka. laws.rule: Authorities may apply the death penalty for murder or rape. The legal drinking age is 21 years. Always carry official photo ID. If you don't, you could be detained. culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Standards of dress and behaviour are conservative. Respect religious traditions and objects. Respect local restrictions and observances around religious holidays. Full moon (Poya) days are celebrated once a month. Authorities ban the sale and purchase of alcohol and fresh meat on these days. Get local advice before you take photos of places of worship and nearby areas. You may cause offence.

remote-work.route: Digital Nomad Visa (one year, renewable), through the Residence Visa Division
remote-work.detail: For remote work, freelancing or a business not registered in Sri Lanka that serves clients outside it. Needs income remitted of at least US$2,000 a month (about A$2,841), a recommendation from the Ministry of Digital Economy, police and medical clearance and health insurance. US$500 a year per person (about A$710). No local employment. Rates: A$1 = US$0.7040, 30 October 2026.
remote-work.next: Apply to the Department of Immigration and Emigration's Residence Visa Division.

entrepreneur.detail: Exploring investment opportunities is covered; other activities are assessed by the Department of Immigration before travel.
entrepreneur.next: Ask the Department of Immigration and Emigration.
